title: Mini Brow Sculpt Shaping and Lifting Gel with Strong Hold
descriptionHtml:
✓ Long-wearing✓ Fragrance Free

What it is: An eyebrow gel that sculpts, shapes, and sets brows—now with a sweatproof, waterproof, and flake-free hold for up to 12 hours.


Highlighted Ingredients:

- Carnauba and Candelilla Wax: Provides lasting hold with a nonsticky, flake-free texture.

- Pro-Vitamin B5: Helps brows look polished and defined.

- Glycerin: Hydrates and nourishs brow hair.


What Else You Need to Know: Sculpt and set your brows for a look that lasts up to 12 hours. With a world-first three-in-one applicator, Brow Sculpt allows you to customize your look, from soft and fluffy to set and laminated. The new, remastered wax-gel formula is flexible, flake-free, sweatproof, and waterproof.

How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Sculpt. Twist cap off to show the spoolie side. Use a small amount of product, brushing forward and backward through the brows to coat all hairs.
-Shape. Pull the cap to show the double-sided brush. Use the comb side to separate and shape the brow hairs.
-Set. Switch to the brush side of the applicator, using it to push brows down and set in place.
-Tip: Brow Sculpt is best applied at the start of your routine on a clean brow.
Ingredients+
Aqua/Water/Eau, Acrylates Copolymer, Paraffin, Glycerin, Butylene Glycol, Cera Microcristallina (Microcrystalline Wax), Stearic Acid, Dimethicone, Mineral Oil (Paraffinum Liquidum), Euphorbia Cerifera (Candelilla) Wax, Cetearyl Alcohol, Cetyl Alcohol, Phenoxyethanol, Copernicia Cerifera (Carnauba) Wax, Polysorbate 80, Triethanolamine, Xanthan Gum, Tocopheryl Acetate, Hydroxypropylmethylcellulose, Disodium EDTA.
